protocol.startingPosition: Standard four-disc initial board; no forced random opening moves
protocol.policySeed: seed+pair*104729+(ply+1)*7919, shared by both roles; policy sampling additionally mixes board

easy.trainingTarget: 20% actual low-Elo move +80% synthetic error-target distribution; distinct from pure imitation

policy.selection: Legal masked trained v2 policy softmax sampling, one network evaluation, no value lookahead
policy.userAuthorization: 就按现在的高档模型，不搜索，作为第二档呢

protocol.search: Exact frozen v2 browser Wasm, default learned-prior PUCT/search selection, independent module per search tier, clear trees before each game, subtree reuse within game
protocol.execution: Sequential matches and decisions; no concurrent strength matches competing for CPU
protocol.limits: 20 games per adjacent pair; screening only, no Elo or human win-rate estimate. Measures deployed book-assisted ladder, not isolated model-only search-time gain.
